_editing_note: Logos shown on the home page. To add one, put a transparent PNG or SVG in assets/source/members/, run `npm run images`, and add an entry with `logo` set to 'members/<filename-without-extension>'.
heading: Among the member organisations
_heading_note: The old home page showed these logos in an unlabelled carousel, immediately after the line 'All the leading industries including the Multinational Companies (MNCs) are its members'. The heading above follows that. Ask the office to confirm the list is current before treating it as authoritative — a few entries could not be identified from the filename alone and are marked `unidentified`.
